reading.body:
James Risch's AI record is mostly money and one bill: three Anthropic PAC contributions and two Google NetPAC contributions of $2,500 each, plus a cosponsorship of the TEST AI Act.

The contributions run from July 2025 to August 2026. Anthropic's committee gives three times, all at $2,500, in August 2026. Google's gives twice, in November 2025 and July 2026. Amazon's PAC gives once, in July 2025. One entry records a contribution of negative $2,500 from Anthropic's committee on the same date as a positive one, which is how a refunded or reversed contribution appears in the filings. The pattern is small and repeated: five-figure-scale checks from the political arms of the largest AI and cloud companies, spread across more than a year.

The legislative side is thinner. Risch cosponsored S. 1633, the TEST AI Act, in May 2025, and voted on S. 2296 across September and October 2025, including cloture, a motion to proceed, a motion to table an amendment, and final passage, which he supported. The data does not name what S. 2296 does, so its relevance to AI cannot be judged from this record alone.

What this does not show is causation. The page states plainly that events are placed in date order and that placement is not a claim one caused another. Nothing here ties a contribution to a vote, and nothing here concerns data centers, power, or compute directly. The money is from AI companies, but it is campaign money, not infrastructure money.

summary: Every dated AI event this site holds for James Risch: bills sponsored or cosponsored, recorded votes on AI bills, and money from AI company and AI-focused political committees, newest first. 19 events.
